description: This file declares functions, macros, and includes for engine mathematics calculations, configuration, and control logic in a vehicle engine control system.

methods.name: setAlgorithm
methods.description: Sets the engine load mode algorithm based on the specified mode.

methods.name: setFlatInjectorLag
methods.description: Sets the flat injector lag time parameter.

methods.name: fixAngle
methods.description: Adjusts the given angle with a message and error code, likely for correction or validation.

methods.name: getCrankshaftRevolutionTimeMs
methods.description: Returns the time in milliseconds for one crankshaft revolution at specified RPM.

methods.name: getEngineCycleDuration
methods.description: Returns the duration of the engine cycle in milliseconds at specified RPM.

methods.name: getEngineLoadT
methods.description: Calculates and returns the current engine load.

methods.name: getSparkDwell
methods.description: Returns the spark dwell time in microseconds at given RPM.

methods.name: getCurrentIgnitionMode
methods.description: Returns the current ignition mode setting.

methods.name: prepareIgnitionPinIndices
methods.description: Prepares ignition pin indices based on ignition mode.

methods.name: getCylinderId
methods.description: Returns the cylinder ID based on an index.

methods.name: setSingleCoilDwell
methods.description: Sets dwell time for a single coil ignition system.
